akimbo:
a. 兩手叉腰的
adv. 兩手叉腰

s. (used of arms and legs) bent outward with the joint away from the body
r. with hands on hips and elbows extending outward
akin: a. 同類的, 同族的, 同源的

s. similar in quality or character
s. related by blood
